raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.desc: Edible in a pinch. Better over a fire.
raw_meat.lore: Hunters say a fire is the difference between a meal and a stomachache.
raw_meat.sources: Dropped by wolves, boars and most beasts.
raw_meat.uses: Eat raw (poor) or cook at a campfire.

cooked_meat.name: Cooked Meat
cooked_meat.lore: The smell alone has turned wolves back from camps.
cooked_meat.sources: Cook raw meat at any campfire.
cooked_meat.uses: Restores a lot of hunger and some HP.

berries.name: Glade Berries
berries.lore: Glenbrook children stain their fingers purple every autumn.
berries.sources: Bushes across the Glades and Highmeadow.
berries.uses: A light snack. Good for topping up on the move.

mushroom.name: Barrow Mushroom
mushroom.lore: Barrow mushrooms grow where the soil is oldest.
mushroom.sources: Forage in damp woodland and near the Old Barrow.
mushroom.uses: Eat, or stew it at a campfire for a proper meal.

mushroom_stew.name: Mushroom Stew
mushroom_stew.lore: Old Ferris claims the recipe is older than the village.
mushroom_stew.sources: Cook Barrow Mushrooms at a campfire.
mushroom_stew.uses: Restores hunger and plenty of HP.

healing_herb.name: Healing Herb
healing_herb.lore: Mira Thistlewood keeps a pouch of these at every hour of the day.
healing_herb.sources: Forage near Glenbrook, Thornwood and meadows.
healing_herb.uses: Eat to restore HP quickly. Hunger is unaffected.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.desc: Coarse grey fur. Ferris might want these.
wolf_pelt.lore: Thick enough to turn a winter wind. Ferris keeps asking for them.
wolf_pelt.sources: Dropped by dire wolves and their cousins.
wolf_pelt.uses: Hunting quest turn-ins and, later, crafting.

boar_tusk.name: Boar Tusk
boar_tusk.lore: A boar will charge through a fence to defend its young.
boar_tusk.uses: Trade good. Some tinkers pay well.

copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
copper_ore.lore: Green-streaked and soft, but it takes a good edge when alloyed.
copper_ore.sources: Mined from rocky ridges: the Barrow ridge, Ironhold.

oak_wood.name: Oak Wood
oak_wood.lore: Seasoned oak burns long and clean.
oak_wood.sources: Fallen branches in any oak woodland.

bandit_insignia.name: Red Fang Insignia
bandit_insignia.lore: Every Red Fang bandit wears one. Losing it is a dishonour among them.
bandit_insignia.uses: Proof for bounty hunters and Garrick.

bloodstone_shard_fragment.name: Bloodstone Shard Fragment
bloodstone_shard_fragment.desc: Warm to the touch. It should not be.
bloodstone_shard_fragment.lore: The fragments hum when they sense one another.
bloodstone_shard_fragment.sources: Story item. Taken from the camp boss.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: Heavy, rust-red rock that miners curse and smiths pray for.
iron_ore.lore: Heavy, rust-red rock that miners curse and smiths pray for.

coal.name: Coal
coal.desc: Black as a crow and twice as loud in the fire.
coal.lore: Black as a crow and twice as loud in the fire.
coal.uses: Fuel for smelting. Smiths buy it by the sack.

sulfur.name: Sulfur
sulfur.desc: Stinks of eggs and ruin; alchemists adore it.
sulfur.lore: Stinks of eggs and ruin; alchemists adore it.

obsidian_shard.name: Obsidian Shard
obsidian_shard.desc: Volcanic glass, sharp enough to shave with.
obsidian_shard.lore: Volcanic glass, sharp enough to shave with.
obsidian_shard.uses: Rare gear component and a scholars curiosity.

amber.name: Amber
amber.desc: Old sap that remembers the forest it came from.
amber.lore: Old sap that remembers the forest it came from.
amber.uses: Sells well. Said to ward off bad luck.

pine_resin.name: Pine Resin
pine_resin.sources: Pines in Thornwood and Hollow Peaks.

bog_lily.name: Bog Lily
bog_lily.desc: A pale bloom that only opens in Gloomfen mist.
bog_lily.lore: A pale bloom that only opens in Gloomfen mist.
bog_lily.uses: Eat to restore HP. Herbalists prize it.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.desc: Faint blue light under the cap; it is safe, mostly.
glowcap.lore: Faint blue light under the cap; it is safe, mostly.
glowcap.uses: Restores a little hunger and HP.

frost_bloom.name: Frost Bloom
frost_bloom.desc: Blooms only where the snow is deepest, and melts in a warm hand.
frost_bloom.lore: Blooms only where the snow is deepest, and melts in a warm hand.
frost_bloom.uses: Eat to restore HP and cool a fever.

cactus_fruit.name: Cactus Fruit
cactus_fruit.desc: Sweet, juicy and worth the spines.
cactus_fruit.lore: Sweet, juicy and worth the spines.
cactus_fruit.uses: Quenches hunger and gives a little HP.

sun_date.name: Sun Date
sun_date.desc: Sticky, sugary and sold by the handful at the bazaar.
sun_date.lore: Sticky, sugary and sold by the handful at the bazaar.
sun_date.sources: Oasis palms in the Sunscorch Dunes.

honeycomb.name: Honeycomb
honeycomb.lore: Golden and dripping. Meadow beekeepers guard theirs fiercely.

pearl_shell.name: Pearl Shell
pearl_shell.desc: A clam that kept a secret and got rich doing it.
pearl_shell.lore: A clam that kept a secret and got rich doing it.

river_trout.name: River Trout
river_trout.uses: Cook at a campfire for a good meal.

roasted_trout.name: Roasted Trout
roasted_trout.sources: Cook River Trout at a campfire.

bone_dust.name: Bone Dust
bone_dust.desc: Ground up by something that did not care for the owner.
bone_dust.lore: Ground up by something that did not care for the owner.
bone_dust.sources: Dropped by undead and swamp horrors.

frost_fang.name: Frost Fang
frost_fang.desc: Cold to the touch even in summer.
frost_fang.lore: Cold to the touch even in summer.
frost_fang.sources: Dropped by snow beasts in the Hollow Peaks.

scorpion_chitin.name: Scorpion Chitin
scorpion_chitin.desc: Hard as horn and surprisingly light.
scorpion_chitin.lore: Hard as horn and surprisingly light.

bog_slime.name: Bog Slime
bog_slime.lore: Gloopy and green. Do not lick.

ancient_coin.name: Ancient Coin
ancient_coin.desc: Stamped with a king nobody remembers.
ancient_coin.lore: Stamped with a king nobody remembers.
ancient_coin.sources: Chests and ruins across the world.

old_key.name: Old Key
old_key.lore: Heavy, pitted iron. Fits something, somewhere.
old_key.uses: Might open a locked door you have not found yet.

bread.name: Bread
bread.desc: A crusty loaf; the world runs on these.
bread.lore: A crusty loaf; the world runs on these.

cheese.name: Cheese
cheese.desc: Sharp, crumbly and good with bread.
cheese.lore: Sharp, crumbly and good with bread.
cheese.uses: Restores hunger and a little HP.
